etymologies.etymologyHTML: From de- +‎ value.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To lower or remove the value of something.

quote.citation: 2023 January 25, Mel Holley, “Network News: London leads the way on rail-related house price surge”, in RAIL, number 975, page 15:
quote.text: Scotland is beaten only by properties in London, which increase in value by 64% on average when within half a mile of a station - although in some cases in the capital, being near to a station devalues the house.
